title: Book Two · Chapter 174: Three on the Record
story:
After lessons, Miss Wu has all six of Ronan's pages on the desk. The fourth one lies flat. The old fold still makes a pale line across its bottom.

“I checked the original pages,” she says. “You did the first, third, and fifth well without help. You made mistakes in the second and sixth. Leo helped with the fourth.”

Ronan nods. He can name them in that order himself.

She shows him the new record. The fourth box now says HELP. The total at the end is three. The record no longer says he can take the final tasks.

“I saw the good answer on this page,” she says. “I missed my own help note inside the fold. I did not open the whole page. That was my mistake.”

“I folded it for my folder.”

“I know. I wrote HELP clearly on your page. Then I copied the result wrongly.”

He looks at the three. It seems smaller on a clean record than it did in his room.

“Will everyone know?” he asks.

“The other three candidates can take the final tasks. Your name will not be on that list. I will tell them about the record correction.”

“Will you tell them I changed a mark?”

“You did not change a mark. I copied the result wrongly. You brought me the original page. That is what I will tell them.”

Ronan breathes out. Miss Wu will tell the others how the mistake happened. He still cannot enter the final tasks on Thursday. His hands feel cold.

“I waited too long,” he says.

“You waited a week. That is part of your choice. You can speak about it if someone asks you.”

She gives him the six pages. He puts them in his folder. This time, he leaves the long fourth page at the top. Its edge sticks out a little.

“You can still use the room during open hours,” Miss Wu says. “The group work has its own times.”

“Yes.”

He looks once more at the checked papers. “Thank you,” he says. Then he leaves.

Leo waits near the gate. Miss Wu has asked him about the fourth task and confirmed his help.

“I remember the desk line,” Leo says.

“So do I.”

They stand together for a moment. Leo's own five marks remain. He will do the final tasks on Thursday.

“Do you want to walk?” he asks.

Ronan shakes his head. “I need a few minutes.”

“All right. Tomorrow?”

“Tomorrow.”

Leo leaves. Ronan sits on the low wall until the yard grows quiet. Then he puts the folder in his bag and walks home by himself.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

original＝原来的、原始的；copy＝抄录；candidate＝候选人；confirm＝确认。

## 理解问题

1. Miss Wu怎样准确区分自己的誊录错误和Ronan的拖延？
2. 这次更正后，哪些普通使用权仍然存在，哪项选拔资格已失去？

## 读句子

**The total at the end is three.**

拆开看：The total at the end / is / three.

末尾的总数／是／三。
